title: 叶节点：Action、Condition 与 Service
html:
叶节点：Action、Condition 与 Service

核心概念

叶节点（Leaf Node）是 BT 中唯一执行实际游戏逻辑的节点——所有 AI 的感知、移动、攻击、动画等操作都在叶节点中实现。三种叶节点类型有严格的职责边界：

graph LR
    L[叶节点] --> C[Condition 节点\n只读、瞬时]
    L --> A[Action 节点\n读写、可异步]
    L --> S[Service 节点\n后台更新、无返回值]
    C --> C1[检查世界状态\n返回 SUCCESS/FAILURE\n同步执行]
    A --> A1[改变世界状态\n可返回 RUNNING\n异步执行]
    S --> S1[定期更新 Blackboard\n附着在组合节点上\n不影响树结构]
叶节点类型 返回 RUNNING？ 修改状态？ 执行时机 典型例子
Condition 否（瞬时） 否（只读） tick 时立即评估 IsInRange, HasAmmo
Action 是（可异步） 是 tick 时开始并持续 MoveTo, Attack, PlayAnim
Service 无返回值 是（写 BB） 周期性后台更新 UpdateNearestEnemy

Condition 节点：瞬时状态检查

Condition 节点必须是无副作用的瞬时操作——它只读取世界状态，立即返回 SUCCESS 或 FAILURE，绝不返回 RUNNING：

class ConditionIsInRange implements BTNode {
  constructor(
    private readonly targetKey: string,
    private readonly selfKey: string,
    private readonly maxRange: number,
  ) {}

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    const target = blackboard.get<Vector3>(this.targetKey, agentId);
    const self = blackboard.get<Vector3>(this.selfKey, agentId);

    if (!target || !self) return NodeStatus.FAILURE;
    const dist = Vector3.distanceSq(self, target);
    return dist <= this.maxRange * this.maxRange ? NodeStatus.SUCCESS : NodeStatus.FAILURE;
  }
}

class ConditionHasAmmo implements BTNode {
  constructor(
    private readonly weaponKey: string,
    private readonly minAmmo = 1,
  ) {}

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    const weapon = blackboard.get<Weapon>(this.weaponKey, agentId);
    return weapon && weapon.ammo >= this.minAmmo ? NodeStatus.SUCCESS : NodeStatus.FAILURE;
  }
}

Condition 节点的设计原则：

  • 每个 Condition 只检查一个条件（单一职责），多个条件用 Sequence 组合
  • 使用 distanceSq 代替 distance，避免 sqrt 开销（条件节点每帧调用）
  • 不做日志或复杂计算，这是高频热路径
  • 允许将游戏系统查询的结果缓存在 Blackboard，Condition 只读 Blackboard

Action 节点：异步行为实现

Action 节点执行实际的游戏行为，可能需要多帧完成，返回 RUNNING 期间需要维护执行上下文：

class ActionMoveTo implements BTNode {
  private navAgent: NavAgent | null = null;
  private targetSnapshot: Vector3 | null = null;

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    const target = blackboard.get<Vector3>('target_position', agentId);
    if (!target) return NodeStatus.FAILURE;

    if (!this.navAgent) {
      // 首次 tick：初始化
      const entity = blackboard.get<Entity>('self_entity', agentId)!;
      this.navAgent = entity.getComponent(NavAgent);
      this.targetSnapshot = target;

      if (!this.navAgent.hasPathTo(target)) {
        return NodeStatus.FAILURE; // 无法到达
      }
      this.navAgent.moveTo(target);
    } else if (!this.targetSnapshot?.equals(target)) {
      // 目标移动了，重新规划路径
      this.navAgent.moveTo(target);
      this.targetSnapshot = target;
    }

    if (this.navAgent.hasReached()) {
      this.navAgent = null;
      this.targetSnapshot = null;
      return NodeStatus.SUCCESS;
    }

    if (this.navAgent.isStuck()) {
      this.navAgent.stop();
      this.navAgent = null;
      return NodeStatus.FAILURE;
    }

    return NodeStatus.RUNNING;
  }

  onAbort(): void {
    // 必须实现：当 BT 中止该节点时清理状态
    this.navAgent?.stop();
    this.navAgent = null;
    this.targetSnapshot = null;
  }
}

class ActionAttack implements BTNode {
  private attackTimer = 0;
  private readonly attackDuration = 0.5;

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    const target = blackboard.get<Entity>('target_entity', agentId);
    if (!target || !target.isAlive()) return NodeStatus.FAILURE;

    if (this.attackTimer <= 0) {
      // 开始攻击
      const self = blackboard.get<Entity>('self_entity', agentId)!;
      self.getComponent(Weapon).fire(target.position);
      this.attackTimer = this.attackDuration;
    }

    const deltaTime = blackboard.get<number>('delta_time')!;
    this.attackTimer -= deltaTime;

    if (this.attackTimer <= 0) {
      return NodeStatus.SUCCESS;
    }
    return NodeStatus.RUNNING;
  }

  onAbort(): void {
    this.attackTimer = 0;
  }
}

Service 节点：后台定期更新

Service 节点附着在组合节点上，不是树的执行路径的一部分——它以固定频率运行，用于周期性更新 Blackboard 数据，将感知/查询结果注入决策层：

class ServiceUpdateNearestEnemy implements ServiceNode {
  private updateInterval: number;
  private lastUpdateTime = -Infinity;

  constructor(intervalSeconds = 0.2) {
    this.updateInterval = intervalSeconds;
  }

  // Service 在所属组合节点 tick 时被调用
  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): void {
    const now = performance.now() / 1000;
    if (now - this.lastUpdateTime < this.updateInterval) return;
    this.lastUpdateTime = now;

    const self = blackboard.get<Entity>('self_entity', agentId)!;
    const enemy = self.getComponent(PerceptionComponent).findNearestEnemy();

    if (enemy) {
      blackboard.set(Keys.TARGET_ENTITY, enemy, agentId);
      blackboard.set(Keys.TARGET_POSITION, enemy.position, agentId);
    } else {
      blackboard.set(Keys.TARGET_ENTITY, null as any, agentId);
      blackboard.set(Keys.TARGET_POSITION, null as any, agentId);
    }
  }
}

Service 在 UE5 中的对应概念：Unreal Engine 5 的 Behavior Tree Editor 有显式的 Service 节点类型，显示为附着在组合节点底部的蓝色方块，与 Task（Action）和 Decorator 明确区分。

PlayAnimation 节点：动画与 BT 集成

动画是 Action 节点中最常见的异步行为之一，需要正确处理动画状态机的过渡：

class ActionPlayAnimation implements BTNode {
  private animController: AnimationController | null = null;
  private animationId: string;
  private waitForCompletion: boolean;

  constructor(animationId: string, waitForCompletion = true) {
    this.animationId = animationId;
    this.waitForCompletion = waitForCompletion;
  }

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    if (!this.animController) {
      const entity = blackboard.get<Entity>('self_entity', agentId)!;
      this.animController = entity.getComponent(AnimationController);
      this.animController.play(this.animationId);

      if (!this.waitForCompletion) {
        this.animController = null;
        return NodeStatus.SUCCESS; // 触发即完成，不等待
      }
    }

    if (this.animController.isFinished(this.animationId)) {
      this.animController = null;
      return NodeStatus.SUCCESS;
    }

    if (this.animController.hasError()) {
      this.animController = null;
      return NodeStatus.FAILURE;
    }

    return NodeStatus.RUNNING;
  }

  onAbort(): void {
    this.animController?.stop(this.animationId);
    this.animController = null;
  }
}

小结

  • Condition 节点：无副作用、瞬时评估、只读 Blackboard，是 BT 逻辑判断的基础单元
  • Action 节点：可返回 RUNNING 表示异步执行，必须实现 onAbort() 做状态清理
  • Service 节点：后台定期更新 Blackboard，将感知/查询结果注入决策层，不影响树执行路径
  • onAbort() 是 Action 节点的安全网：没有正确清理的 Action 会导致游戏对象状态错乱
  • Condition 节点应极度轻量：避免 sqrt/物理查询/字符串操作等高开销操作
  • Service 更新频率（0.1-0.5 秒）远低于帧率，将感知开销与决策开销解耦
